messages:
ashwin: FYI customer (Acme) asked us to prioritize onboarding Hemlock-27B. They saw big output quality drops after our 4-bit quant experiments. Can we triage?

maria: +1. Can you paste the failing examples or eval numbers?

ashwin: Here are a couple quick numbers from their eval harness: fp16 PPL=12.4, 4-bit quantized PPL=28.9. They ran our default q4_0 profile with sequence length 1024.

zach: Oof. That gap usually means mismatch in tokenizer / eos handling or KV-cache side effects. Did they use the exact hf tokenizer we serve?

ashwin: They said yes, but I asked them to attach the model config. Their run command:
```bash
python run_eval.py --model ./hemlock-27b/ --tokenizer hemlock-tokenizer/ --quant q4_0 --seq_len 1024 --batch 4
```

rachel: Can we get a small reproducible test on our infra? I'll try a quick run on a similar card (A100s) with our q4_0 pipeline. If it reproduces we escalate to quant eng.

ci-bot: CI task queued: hemlock-27b/quick-quant-smoke on pool "qc-a100". Job ID: #22418.

maria: While that runs, checklist suggestion for onboarding triage: 
- confirm tokenizer & special tokens match production
- run fp16 baseline on our infra with same prompts
- run q4_0 smoke with deterministic seeds
- compare decoded outputs (diff, token-level)
- sanity-check KV-cache correctness with multi-chunk generation
- check for fused-op fallbacks in runtime logs
- if mismatch persists, try q4_1 / per-channel quant profiles

ashwin: I'll own tokenizer and decoded diffs. Rachel - you take the smoke runs. Zach - can you look at runtime logs (kernel fallback, mem alignment) if CI reproduces?

zach: Yep. If we see different oppaths I'll dump the kernel selection trace. Also check for these two quick gotchas: 
1) model exported with padding side="right" vs our serving expecting "left"
2) positional embeddings trimmed vs full length causing misalignment

rachel: CI results: fp16 PPL = 12.6 (matches customer), q4_0 PPL = 29.1 (reproduced). attaching condensed logs: 
```
[inf] loading model hemlock-27b
[warn] q4_0 dequant fallback: scaled matmul path -> slow path
[err] kv_cache_mismatch detected at step 24 (chunk boundary)
```

maria: kv_cache_mismatch is a big clue. That explains divergence after multi-chunk generation. Likely a packing/stride bug in our quant kernel for that model shape.

ashwin: Good catch. Next steps:
- Zach to prepare kernel repro case and assign to eng-runtime (ETA 24h)
- Rachel to run alternative quant profile q4_1 and q8_0 to surface sensitivity (ETA 6h)
- Maria to draft customer note explaining we reproduced and are investigating (I'll CC support)

ci-bot: Ticket created: RT-5042 "hemlock-27b q4_0 kv-cache mismatch" assigned to eng-runtime. Priority: P1 for customer SLA.

rachel: Quick numbers: q4_1 PPL=13.8, q8_0 PPL=12.7. So q4_1 is close-ish but q4_0 is broken. Adding as experiment logs to the ticket.

zach: I'll attach kernel trace and a minimal C++ repro. If it's a packing bug we can patch with an alignment fix and re-run smoke.

maria: Action items summarized: 
- ashwin: collect customer diffs + confirm tokenizer (in progress)
- rachel: alternative quant runs + infra verification (in progress)
- zach: kernel trace + repro + eng-runtime handoff (todo)
- maria: customer comms + ticket updates (todo)

ashwin: Thanks team. I'll update Acme now with interim workaround (use q4_1 or q8_0) and ETA 24-48h for a patch. :thumbsup:

rachel: tagging @eng-oncall for visibility if the runtime patch needs a hotfix deployment.

ci-bot: Note: job #22418 completed (status: reproduced). Logs uploaded to internal storage: link: https://internal.redwood/models/hemlock-27b/22418/logs

ashwin: Closing the triage thread for now — followups in RT-5042. If anyone wants to add quick notes drop them here.
